name: Crumbling Floor

source.title: Pathfinder Society Scenario #5-16: A Lie Told to Strangers

stealth.details: (trained) to notice the worn flagstones which are crumbling away at the slightest pressure.

disable: DC 17 Acrobatics check (trained) to safely navigate the wet floor without stepping on any loose masonry or DC 19 Thievery check (expert) to cause a controlled collapse without any danger to the PCs.

items.name: Collapse
items.text:
Trigger A creature moves into the hazardous area

---

Effect The flooring crumbles, breaking apart under the creature and sending them into the stagnant water below, dealing 2d12+12 bludgeoning damage (DC 20 basic Reflex save save). That creature can use the Grab an Edge reaction to avoid falling.

text: At a cursory glance the tunnel appears to be little more than a waterlogged chamber.
